newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean trade minister out in cabinet reshuffle.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean trade minister out in cabinet reshuffle.

text.p: South Korea's trade minister Park Jae-yoon will be replaced by his deputy, Ahn Kwang-koo, in a partial cabinet reshuffle, a spokesman for the presidential Blue House said on Friday.
The spokesman said the reshuffle was prompted by the need to appoint an ambassador to the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development, which Seoul joined this month.
South Korea's first ambassador to the Paris-based club of rich nations will be Koo Bohn-young, the current minister of Science and Technology.
Earlier, Yonhap news agency incorrectly reported the new trade minister would be the current deputy finance minister Lee Hwan-kyun.
Replacing Koo at the science ministry will be Kim Yong-jin, who now works in the prime minister's office.
There was no word on the future of the current minister of Trade, Industry and Energy.

Also changing are the ministers of Agriculture and Forestry, Political Affairs, Environment, Government Administration, Legislation, Patriots and Veteran Affairs and the head of the National Police Agency.
The position of Kim's chief bodyguard will become a cabinet-level job.
All the new appointments will take effect on Friday afternoon after the new appointees receive their credentials from President Kim, a Blue House spokesman said.
